## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      2 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 02.02.2026 - 13.07.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Miles Roche_, 02.02.2026, 4/5: "This is an amazing app! I love the ui design and feel. It is perfect apart from a few minor/annoying bugs I have found. Apart from those, its perfect! I've noticed that you can't change the order of the tasks in checklists or rename them without starting again, and the back button during the workout menu doesn't work. ilI would also love to see some improvement of the actual workouts. If I could change the reps and weights without having to go back and edit the workout it would be much better."
